Arosa Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Kinder Morgan Inc Del for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $35.45B market cap company. (NYSE:KMI) has declined 28.25% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.80% the S&P500.
